verdict.rationale: Bolna documents AI-generated per-call outputs inside the product. These are LLM call summaries, toggled per agent, and model-backed extraction categories configured in the Analytics tab. Together they turn call data into structured insights. Evidence stops at per-call summarization and extraction, with no aggregate insight layer or proactive suggestions shown. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, cross-call or aggregate insights over account data, depth documentation of summary and extraction outputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Call summaries are an agent-level toggle: call_summary_enabled (boolean, off by default) on the agent create and update APIs
